en.quote: …to reduce the energy intensity of the Russian Federation’s GDP by at least 40 percent by 2020 compared with 2007…
en.head: The reduction by 2020 was far below 40%.
en.body: The decree targeted a reduction in GDP energy intensity of at least 40% from 2007 to 2020. An AVOK analysis estimated a fall of about 17% over that period for the measure excluding non-energy uses. The calculation method affects the result, but this estimate is far below the target.
en.meta_context: Decree No. 889, “On Measures to Improve Energy and Environmental Efficiency…”

osrc.t: Delovoy Peterburg, citing a Ministry of Economic Development report
